upstream.dispatch: brainForced invokes doFleeing when native fleeing is true.
upstream.foot: doFleeing clears group building memory, finds nearby enemy, may stop/prone under overhead cover, otherwise searches terrain/buildings and moves to cover; distant/unseen branch recalls leader and resets stance. It can write strong posture, forceSpeed and ACE lastFired.
upstream.mounted: At low grounded speed it may replace dead gunner, eject/reboard or abandon according to native mobility/fuel/ammo/damage and chance.
upstream.departs: Do not copy unconditional strong posture, full speed reset, global group-memory erasure, live unseen enemy geometry or blind delayed crew actions over mission/Zeus/medical ownership.

currentCBE.forced: Mode classifies native flight as FORCED. CanContinue allows its original finite wait; Act does not issue a fleeing destination. Recycle has no FORCED continuation. Existing ownership guards yield to native flight.
currentCBE.withdrawal: Morale and Retreat implement group pressure/overmatch withdrawal through a separate finite operation. This is not evidence of individual fleeing-cover/rejoin parity.
currentCBE.capacityDistinction: Capabilities reads usable inventory/health. TacticalAssess separately filters current fire-task availability. Replacing morale inventory capability with temporary fire-task availability could spuriously classify a busy launcher as permanently absent; no such change made.

openMaterialGap.description: CBE has no explicit actor-level counterpart to LAMBS doFleeing cover/rejoin path. Yielding to native flight may be correct ownership policy but does not prove equivalent movement or exclude a stalled native-flee state under the replacement danger FSM.
openMaterialGap.minimumEvidence: When audits are authorised, compare a known fleeing actor under native versus CBE danger FSM: actual destination changes, travel/cover, task replacement and recovery. Until then no assertion that native engine movement fills this gap.
openMaterialGap.implementationConstraints: Any demonstrated missing response must use existing finite owner-local actor execution with original deadline, witnessed stagnation, known threat geometry, native task and Zeus interruption, exact cleanup and no perpetual duplicate controller. Mounted flight remains a separate crew-domain design.

executionTraceFollowup.scope: Read-only forced-flight execution and reuse analysis; no movement implementation or runtime claim
executionTraceFollowup.fsm: DangerEngineMode classifies fleeing as FORCED; Check_self invokes DangerEngineAct; its finite deadline reaches Check_self_2/Check_queue and End_Forced invokes DangerEngineRelease. FORCED has no movement branch or positive recycle budget.
executionTraceFollowup.cleanup: DangerEngineRelease clears the response marker and defers owned stance restoration while native fleeing persists. This is posture cleanup, not escape travel or native movement acknowledgement.
reuseConstraints: DangerCoverStep refuses fleeing actors before admission. It has one group cover lease and only recalls an exact owned failed approach when the leased actor is no longer fleeing; removing the veto would change ownership and cannot represent independent flight for multiple soldiers.

PointActorOperation and IndoorActorOperation exclude fleeing in admission and cleanup. They implement investigation, not flight; dispatching forced flight through these executors would be a semantic and ownership change.

LAMBS doFleeing operates on foot and mounted actors differently. Its unconditional posture reset, group-memory erasure, unseen enemy geometry and delayed crew actions are not safe replacements for these CBE guards.
executionTraceFollowup.nextDecision: Do not weaken existing investigation/cover ownership gates to claim flight parity. A distinct finite actor-flight execution path needs original deadline and native-order proof, passive yield to existing native movement, generation/locality/Zeus/medical interruption and exact cleanup. Native-versus-CBE physical destination/travel comparison remains required to establish whether and where native movement stalls.
